control.prompt: Welcome to VoiceForge. The appointment is at 10:45 on November 19. Please write down the reference number, 7462, before we continue. When you are ready, listen for the pause between these two sentences.

short.prompt: Your order is ready. Pick it up at gate five.

narration.prompt: When the rain finally stopped, the crew walked down the platform and waited for the evening train. A few minutes later, the station lights came on. Beyond the tracks, the last patch of sunlight disappeared behind the hills.

notes: Bars compare request-level median time to first PCM over loopback HTTP, including queue wait. The control repeats the previous prompt. Short and narration are additional workloads.
